## VSiN on this hire — The Coaching Carousel Never Stops

*Adam Burke, p. 32. GUIDE CONTENT — TTW reference notes summarising the guide's assessment; the judgement is the guide's.*

Adam Burke's assessment is blunt and self-aware: it might be unfair to call a College Football Hall of Famer an underwhelming hire, but this is an underwhelming hire. He records that Fitzgerald was dismissed from Northwestern in 2023 following an investigation into hazing and sexual assault, that a thorough investigation was completed and Fitzgerald was shown the door, and then raises his own counterfactual — whether Fitzgerald would have had more programme support if the team had not gone 1-11 the previous season and 3-9 the season before that. Either way, he writes, Fitzgerald, a volunteer coach at his son's high school for the last three seasons, gets another chance after the aspirational hire of Jonathan Smith did not work out. His conclusion is that the ceiling in East Lansing feels very low moving forward.
